Priya — thanks for the forward. I've created internal case CASE-7893 and attached the deletion checklist we'll use (redwood-deletion-checklist.csv). Proposed operational plan:

1) Triage (today): validate request ID, verify signed authorization matches Zephyr account owner, map conversation to internal message IDs and indexes.
2) Purge (1–3 business days): remove conversation rows from per-customer message store, delete indexed search entries, and invalidate KV/prefix caches.
3) Traces & metrics (3–4 business days): scrub per-request traces, redact token-level logs where present, and mark audit record with deletion event.
4) Backups & archives (estimate 5–20 business days): coordinate with infra to identify recovery windows for S3 snapshots / offsite archives in eu-west-1 and apply excision where feasible. Note: immutable archival copies and third-party backups may impose retention windows we cannot circumvent without legal escalation.

I'll need Legal to confirm whether we can delete forensic artifacts that are tagged for compliance. Aditya / Laura, any concerns? Also: we will capture all steps in CASE-7893 and provide Zephyr with a deletion summary when complete.

Hi Alice — thanks for sending the authorization. We received your request (ZE-210) and have opened internal case CASE-7893. Next steps and expected timeline below: 

- Triage / verification (today): confirm authorization / account ownership (COMPLETE)
- Operational purge (1–3 business days): message store, search indexes, traces and KV cache invalidation
- Backups & archives (5–20 business days): infra will assess eu-west-1 snapshots and offsite archives and attempt excision where feasible; we will escalate if any archived copies are in immutable storage and require legal process.

What we will do: remove the conversation from live operational logs, search indexes, and per-request traces stored in our EU region, and record the deletion event in CASE-7893. What we may not be able to remove immediately: copies in long-term immutable archives or third-party backups beyond Redwood's direct control.

Please confirm in writing that Zephyr wishes Redwood to proceed under the terms described above. If the attached authorization is the final approval, reply with "Proceed" and we will start the purge plan immediately. We'll send incremental status updates in CASE-7893 and provide a final deletion summary upon completion.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Product Operations, Redwood Inference
